content.comment_body: I set up the system shown in the attached image, but Q8 won't function. Both the controller and expansion module are at 230V.
The expansion module also requires a 230V AC power supply, just like the main controller.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered an issue with output Q8 not operating in a setup using a [product_name] controller and expansion module, both at 230V. Another user clarified that the expansion module needed its own 230V power supply, not just the main controller. This highlights a potential misunderstanding about separate power requirements for expansion modules.
analysis.user_expectations: The user assumed the expansion module would work with only the main controller supplied with 230V power.
